title: Nurse speaks for first time in Virginia

tellings.quote: there was also, I think, a nurse there who had worked under you. And for the first time, she started to speak about this being.

plain: A nurse in Virginia who had worked under a surgeon named Amar began, for the first time, to speak about a being that was said to have been operated on at his hospital. Michels says this to Amar himself, recalling what he had been told, and it would mean a second person from the hospital backs up the surgeon's account.
